specifications.terrazzo-master.png: Seamless repeating pale warm ivory terrazzo floor. Extremely fine cream, beige and muted-grey aggregate. Perfect overhead orthographic view, uniform lighting, no objects, grout grid, vignette, directional highlights or floor-light stripes. Quiet detailed hand-painted game texture. Square1024x1024.
specifications.room-kit-master.png: Transparent modern oak/ivory/forest-green congress-centre sprite sheet. High-angle top-down, no isometric diagonals. Separate left and right vertical wall modules, slim oak-framed matte-green presentation display with no text, and a modern oak/terrazzo lectern with tablet/microphone. Native32-person proportions. Reference architecture kit used for material coherence.
specifications.architectural-depth-kit-master.png: Transparent contemporary architectural depth kit. Long ivory/oak north wall with recessed blue-grey windows, forest-green frames, sill depth, acoustic piers and warm sconces; separate open doorway jambs without an overhead lintel; corner pier; broad two-tread oak stage steps with copper nosings. High-angle orthographic game camera, no palace ornament. Diamond-topped corner pier was rejected from implementation.
specifications.planter-coffee-kit-master.png: Transparent low oak/copper divider planter with ferns, olive foliage and a few cream flowers; separate small brushed-steel/green espresso machine, wooden drip tray and four cups. High-angle orthographic modern congress-centre game props, no people, text, floor or logos.
